retract_between_bites.rationale: Working on a laptop, the arm should not block the laptop view.

robot_speed.rationale: Fatigue and limited motor control favor slow, safe motion regardless of the working context.

skewering_axis.rationale: Slow mouth opening and fatigue favor narrower bites that are easier to take.

transfer_mode.rationale: The user cannot lean forward due to limited trunk control, so inside-mouth delivery is required.

wait_before_autocontinue_seconds.rationale: Slow assistive input, divided attention from working, and fatigue all warrant the longest response window.
